'''Lathe''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] hailing from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]]. A [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] affiliated with the [[Veiled Sorority/Legends|Veiled Sorority]], Lathe was active during the Sorority's conflict with the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
A slicer operating on Saleucami during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Lathe worked with the [[Veiled Sorority/Legends|Veiled Sorority]] maintaining the SororiNet node installed on the planet. Residing in an apartment in [[Taleucema]], Lathe seldom left the confines of her home, leaving only to resupply herself with [[Booster Blue|booster blue]]. Carrying brass knuckles as a defensive weapon, Lathe was born during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="MPQ" />
